resources.description: Fictional learning resource. All metrics are illustrative. The download contains a shared demo manifest, not this full resource.
resources.usageExample:
import json

with open("axonhub-demo-manifest.json", encoding="utf-8") as file:
    manifest = json.load(file)
dataset = next(resource for resource in manifest["resources"] if resource["type"] == "dataset")
for row in dataset["sample"]:
    print(row["language"], row["sentiment"], row["text"])

steps: Inspect the sample configuration; no model is executed.
